payload.title: Write and step RISC-V assembly in the browser
payload.description:
As the student, I want to type RISC-V assembly, run it, and step through it watching registers and memory.

Feature: Assembly in the browser
  Scenario: Run and step
    Given a program that adds two numbers and prints the result
    When I run it
    Then the terminal shows the result
    When I step back
    Then the registers return to their previous values
  Scenario: A syntax error is marked
    Given an assembly line with an unknown instruction
    Then the editor marks that line with the error
